10266|6e63d362.name: Ug'thok
10266|6e63d362.text: You learn quickly, that is not a bad thing. Just be sure to do the job right, as long as it takes to do so. Now, I fear I must send you to Snarl to learn more. Learn what he can teach, but do not listen to his angry words. He gets that way when Saru's daughters laugh at him.

10278|46a7802e.name: Thrag Stonehoof
10278|46a7802e.text: Karn says we need to listen to the spirits of the forge and of the steel, that they will guide us. I hear nothing but a ringing in my ears. Here, take a hammer and let us try to hear the spirits together.

10278|af34ad47.name: Thrag Stonehoof
10278|af34ad47.text: I guess the spirits like you better than me, I still have not heard their call but you seem to have gathered their lessons well. Go speak to Karn, he will be excited to see one who hears them as he does.

10668|36aec325.name: Beaten Corpse
10668|36aec325.text:
You turn the body over and see the marks from blades and spells upon the deceased orc--her armor all but destroyed, her hair matted to her face.

Based on Mankrik's description of her, there is no doubt in your mind that this was his wife.

He will be upset by the news, but you are sure he should know the truth.

10668|3a2756d2.name: Beaten Corpse
10668|3a2756d2.text:
The body is that of a female orc $c.

It is clear that she died in battle, probably against the quilboar in the area.

10881|dc8290dc.name: Bluff Runner Windstrider
10881|dc8290dc.text: Greetings and salutations, hero!  I have the latest news from both continents and points beyond for your consideration.

11044|386a9ec7.name: Doctor Martin Felben
11044|386a9ec7.text: Once, it is true, I was human. What might otherwise be a shortcoming works to our advantage, $N, for I know human weaknesses intimately.

11049|8b5e44c8.name: Rhiannon Davis
11049|8b5e44c8.text: Good, you've got some grit! I like that. Well then, let's get going!

11066|f7f14434.name: Jhag
11066|f7f14434.text: You come to wrong place. Talk to the expert Godan over there. You learn more from him.

11067|28cbb649.name: Malcomb Wynn
11067|28cbb649.text: Eh, well you've made it this far... go see Lavinia Crowe by the other bookshelf there. If you don't mess things up with her, maybe you can learn some more.

11074|650fd33a.name: Hgarth
11074|650fd33a.text: You have reached new heights in your path to mastery. Let us see if we can take you even further...

11074|fcc0e349.name: Hgarth
11074|fcc0e349.text: Have you come to seek the knowledge of Hgarth?

11833|eb2e4319.name: Rahauro
11833|eb2e4319.text:
Well met, $c. You may speak to me unless you have direct business with my mistress Magatha.

I deal with most of her tasks for her so she can concentrate on more important matters. Perhaps there are some things we could discuss before you seek audience with her?

11860|ae16ea2b.name: Maggran Earthbinder
11860|ae16ea2b.text: I am afraid that I am no longer gentle or humble. Age and countless battles have hardened my skin and soul. Perhaps that is why Cairne assigned me to Sun Rock Retreat... the gentle winds and warm sun does ease the pain.

11861|2ff59fb5.name: Mor'rogal
11861|2ff59fb5.text:
Stonetalon Mountain has many perilous caves through out this region.  Exploring these caves can hold many adventures for those willing to risk life for glory.

$C, perhaps you seek riches that only following your heart and soul can garnish.

12196|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Kaylisk
12196|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

12616|c5ceacbe.name: Vhulgra
12616|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

12696|f1d5ba87.name: Senani Thunderheart
12696|f1d5ba87.text: Do you hear the call of the hunt, $c?  You must listen closely, but the call comes from deep within you.  It comes from deep within all of us.

12724|39b67c2e.name: Pixel
12724|39b67c2e.text: This forest can be confusing! Be careful out there.

12737|aa838c4f.name: Mastok Wrilehiss
12737|aa838c4f.text:
If you want to know about the comings and goings of caravans and merchants here in Splintertree Post, then I am fortunately the orc you are looking for.  Unfortunately for you though, I don't like people.

If you want something, make it quick.

13417|1605f087.name: Sagorne Creststrider
13417|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

13417|8fca8484.name: Sagorne Creststrider
13417|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

1383|da72a588.name: Snarl
1383|da72a588.text: So you think you are good enough to learn from me? The great Snarl? You are no more than a lowly worm beneath my boot. However, taking on an underling might make me seem more appealing to Sumi and Tumi. Let's see what meager skills you possess.

15116|19dfe25a.name: Grinkle
15116|19dfe25a.text:
Hey Hey Hey!  I am here to promote a fabulous fishing tournament in Stranglethorn but you need to be tough enough to survive there and have enough skill in fishing to fish those waters.

 Come back later when you are more qualified!

16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1938|cd4928e4.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
1938|cd4928e4.text: The Kirin Tor did not heed my warnings! The Alliance is a sham. Arugal is a reckless fool.

2121|bf7b697c.name: Shadow Priest Allister
2121|bf7b697c.text: Information... With our scouts and agents, we control the flow of information in Lordaeron. Scourge movements, their holdings, all underneath our watchful eyes...

2128|7d510daf.name: Cain Firesong
2128|7d510daf.text: Greetings.  I'm an $r $c trainer, and you're a $c.

2216|8e0e34da.name: Apothecary Lydon
2216|8e0e34da.text: We are but so close to developing the New Plague that our Dark Lady desires with such fervor.

2226|dd7de3ae.name: Karos Razok
2226|dd7de3ae.text: Greetings.  Our bats are well trained and fed.  You'll not find faster.

2388|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Shay
2388|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

2391|5dffcf15.name: Serge Hinott
2391|5dffcf15.text: Another interruption. How am I supposed to get any work done like this? Don't answer that; do I look as if I care what you have to say? Why don't you go bother Mr. High-And-Mighty instead?

2425|7dca81fc.name: Varimathras
2425|7dca81fc.text:
Do not presume to speak to me as though you are my equal, $c. Sylvanas is my queen, and I will do as she bids.

If you do not show the proper respect, I assure you, we can find a more than suitable place for you in the Nether.

But there is no reason we cannot have words if you wish to aid the Dark Lady...

265944|0c543544.name: William Pickman
265944|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

266484|e94c420f.name: Morbin Lightbane
266484|e94c420f.text:
We paladins must earn our place amongst our Forsaken kin each day, lest we be judged as fanatics like the Scarlet Crusade. The light is not simply a tool of our foes, but a conduit for our righteous fury! It is in our devotion to the Dark Lady and the love of our home that we may channel the light to bring justice to our enemies.

The Banshee Queen keeps a close eye on us. Let her. She will see that our resolve shall never waver. We are Forsaken!

268048|53fff4bc.name: Darkspear Emissary
268048|53fff4bc.text: I am sorry, $c, but you are not experienced enough yet to enter Darkspear Islands.

268925|17da1992.name: Night Elf Courier
268925|17da1992.text: The night elf is motionless, with multiple wounds and discoloration emblematic of suffering from poison.

270582|e6b98502.name: Mon'ye
270582|e6b98502.text:
Greetings, $c.

I can show you how to weave magic about yourself to change the appearance of your equipment, if you so desire. Do you wish to utilize my services?

2934|2cd97b51.name: Keeper Bel'dugur
2934|2cd97b51.text: Knowledge is both tool and weapon to those with the will to use it.

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

2998|19ec09c0.name: Karn Stonehoof
2998|19ec09c0.text: Everything has a spirit, if you learn to listen to it you can get it to take any shape you want. Blacksmithing isn't about beating metal, forcing it to do your will. It's about listening to the spirit within the steel and guiding it to the shape you know it wants to take.

3026|0c543544.name: Aska Mistrunner
3026|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

3040|08830bac.name: Urek Thunderhorn
3040|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

3040|3f898c12.name: Urek Thunderhorn
3040|3f898c12.text: Do you prefer guns or bows?

3043|08830bac.name: Ker Ragetotem
3043|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

3043|4711dbab.name: Ker Ragetotem
3043|4711dbab.text: No matter how much one learns, there is always more to know.

3084|73a86360.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|73a86360.text: Brek Stonehoof can be found at Stonehoof Geology on the lower rise and can teach you the proper way to harvest precious ores and gems.

3084|8c257f1a.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|8c257f1a.text: Aspiring to join our ranks one day?  Sark Ragetotem can help you on your way.  He's in the Hunter's Hall.

3084|de5042ab.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|de5042ab.text: Look on the lower rise opposite the auctioneers if you would like to get your mane trimmed.

3084|f7079359.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|f7079359.text:
There is no finer cook in Thunder Bluff than Aska Mistrunner.  Mmmmm, I can smell what she is cooking from here.  Head over to her kitchen located on the high rise.

Drat... now I am hungry.

3143|e14f5e15.name: Gornek
3143|e14f5e15.text: The Valley of Trials will temper even the weakest into a warrior worthy to join the Horde. Those who cannot rise to its tests will be left to bake in the scorching desert sun.

3216|13f1d3f9.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|13f1d3f9.text:
Listen closely to what you are told and do not quickly trust, or distrust.  For even friends serve their own ends, $c.

Our great Warchief knows this, and to prove that there are warlocks within the Horde who do not wish to destroy it from within or gain control over it, I have volunteered to aid our young leader in anyway I can.

3216|1672ee12.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|1672ee12.text:
Naive fool. The Burning Blade IS the Shadow Council! There are many cults and organizations under the Council's rule, but all of them are just extensions of their will. I may lead the Burning Blade, but I am still just as much a pawn to the Council as you are to me!

Look at the Searing Blade--most of them think they are becoming the next rising group of powerful warlocks that they will replace the Shadow Council.

3216|2e9c14b6.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|2e9c14b6.text: Haha! Save for their leaders--the satyr, Bazzalan, and the warlock Jergosh--yes, all of them. That is why I constantly send Thrall's worshippers at them. It gives Thrall the impression that I am weeding out the evil in the bowels of his great city. The victory is in reality two-fold: kill Thrall's faithful and test the strength of those in the Searing Blade to see if they are truly worthy of joining me.

3216|9353e287.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|9353e287.text:
Ah, one of our own. It is good to see our numbers are growing so rapidly that I can no longer keep track of the faces of our members.

That fool Thrall thinks I am working hard to cleanse the image of warlocks and prove we are his servants. Idiot! The Burning Legion will make ash of this entire world after it drains it completely.

3216|e0c203bc.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|e0c203bc.text: I will make it known to you. You are obviously already proving yourself in our ranks to become a lieutenant so quickly. Perhaps you can return to me later and I will have tasks for you. The council adores those skilled in the arcane, but servants of all kinds are always welcome, no matter their profession.

3296|2213d915.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|2213d915.text: Talk to Saru Steelfury at The Burning Anvil.  Go to the Valley of Honor.  It's at the end of the path to the right of Red Canyon Mining.

3296|ce1ceb20.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|ce1ceb20.text: Speak to Grezz Ragefist in the Hall of the Brave, which is in the Valley of Honor.  Put in a good word for me!

3309|ae78a458.name: Karus
3309|ae78a458.text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

3324|031480cd.name: Grol'dar
3324|031480cd.text: You know enough to be dangerous, but you still look like you need training to me $N.

3324|8fca8484.name: Grol'dar
3324|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

3344|1605f087.name: Kardris Dreamseeker
3344|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

3345|75a71456.name: Godan
3345|75a71456.text: Your skills are out of my league, stranger.Talk to Hgarth at the Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains. He will provide you with more knowledge than I can.

3353|640f312b.name: Grezz Ragefist
3353|640f312b.text: Are you here for training?  Or are you just here to waste a $c's time.

3365|0443423e.name: Karolek
3365|0443423e.text: The twists and turns of Orgrimmar are designed to thwart invaders. Can you imagine how quickly one of those puny gnomes would get lost in here? Ha! If it was lucky, I'd track it down and keep it as a pet.

3368|5a0b913d.name: Borstan
3368|5a0b913d.text: I have the finest meats in Orgrimmar.

3390|eb12150e.name: Apothecary Helbrim
3390|eb12150e.text: The Barrens holds a wealth of substances for which we, the apothecaries or Lordaeron, may find use.

3391|8f749700.name: Gazlowe
3391|8f749700.text: Thrall paid me and my boys well for helping out with the construction of Orgrimmar, so I decided to set up a port here. We do most of our business through Booty Bay and Baron Revilgaz.

3399|48c1c064.name: Zamja
3399|48c1c064.text: Wulan in Shadowprey Village can sell you the "Expert Cookbook".  You will need that if you are to better yourself.

3419|dabc0513.name: Apothecary Zamah
3419|dabc0513.text: For our people to survive, we must study the ways of nature and learn its secrets.

3429|4e7d06f7.name: Thork
3429|4e7d06f7.text:
Welcome to the Crossroads, $c. My name is Thork--I lead the defenses here in the name of the Warchief.

Please, feel free to make yourself at home. As long as you mind your business, no one should have any problem with you taking up some space.

There are many threats to our safety here. If you've already become familiar with the lay of the land, speak to the others here--perhaps they have tasks for you to do.

3432|c1a3099b.name: Mankrik
3432|c1a3099b.text:
I came to the Crossroads from the south seeking help, $c, but I find only cowards who turn their backs on me--even the mighty Thork insults me so. He is a good leader, but his dismissal of my plea causes me greater anger.

He claims my rage makes me hasty--that it clouds my judgement--but I will not rest until I have vengeance!

3442|ef9d74c5.name: Sputtervalve
3442|ef9d74c5.text: Director Riddlevox put me in charge of the Union's shredder development program. Few months on the job and I'm already in hot water! I could use your help, $N!

3446|36457281.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
3446|36457281.text:
Yes yes yes!  You're just the $r I'm looking for!

Sit!  We have much to discuss!!

3448|dcea3712.name: Tonga Runetotem
3448|dcea3712.text: The times we live in are as fickle as the shifting winds, $c.  It is important to remember what is true and lasting in this world, and to preserve that.  Everything else is a waste.

3453|48c11c0f.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
3453|48c11c0f.text: Something I can help you with, $N? There's a shipment I've got to see to otherwise.

3483|aa3c8600.name: Jahan Hawkwing
3483|aa3c8600.text: The Barrens, with its hot sun and hostile denizens, is the perfect place to test your strength and fortitude.

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

3934|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Boorand Plainswind
3934|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

4312|c5ceacbe.name: Tharm
4312|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

4576|4eaf08fa.name: Josef Gregorian
4576|4eaf08fa.text: I will instruct you when the time is right... that time is not now. You have much more to learn first!

4616|6d8c45cf.name: Lavinia Crowe
4616|6d8c45cf.text: If I wasn't stuck here day in and day out, I would have attained the mastery required to train the likes of you! Unfortunately that's not the case. Go talk to Hgarth at the Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains.

4949|9255c79c.name: Thrall
4949|9255c79c.text:
It would be wise to explain to you the depths at which our enemies will go to to hide themselves under our noses.

Know this first and foremost: our enemy is the Shadow Council. No matter what task I give you, or who I ask you to act against, know that one simple fact.

Many cults exist within the Council, but only to hide its actions against the foolish.

Groups like the Burning Blade, the Argus Wake, and the Searing Blade are all tools of the Council. Consider them one and the same.

4949|9a2b62b8.name: Thrall
4949|9a2b62b8.text:
All members of the Horde are equal in my eyes, $N. We have all suffered many burdens, and if it were not for wisdom and honor, then we would be no better than the Scourge or my people while our blood was tainted by the demon Mannoroth.

It is your duty to aid the Horde and to defend our way of life. But it is also your duty to know when quarter and compassion should be given to friend and foe alike.

Understand this well. This is the new Horde, not some demon-spawned army who lack freewill.

5688|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Renee
5688|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

5759|a28d29e1.name: Nurse Neela
5759|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

5811|e65e27ca.name: Kamari
5811|e65e27ca.text: I have nothing more to teach you. Talk to Karolek if you wish to further your leatherworking skills.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

6791|60c5da07.name: Innkeeper Wiley
6791|60c5da07.text: Come in, come in. Just don't sit too close to the stove. It hasn't exploded yet today, but just to be safe I think you should sit elsewhere.

7683|a4ef73af.name: Alessandro Luca
7683|a4ef73af.text: Welcome to Blue Moon Odds and Ends, $c.  If you have any questions, please let me know.

7731|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Jayka
7731|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

8359|6fec0ef7.name: Ahanu
8359|6fec0ef7.text: Greetings.  If you are here for leather goods, then you will find my wares well crafted.

5041-progress.name: Thork
5041-progress.text: How goes your search for the supplies, $N? I trust the quilboar fall under your strength easily.
5041-progress.title: Supplies for the Crossroads

6301-progress.name: Tammra Windfield
6301-progress.text: The continuous destruction caused by war and those that seek a profit from lumber pains me deeply. To aid the cycle of rebirth and replenish the lands, I need Gaea seeds. Do you have them, $c?
6301-progress.title: Cycle of Rebirth

6361-progress.name: Devrak
6361-progress.text: Are you here for a wind rider?  You have something to transport?
6361-progress.title: A Bundle of Hides

6362-progress.name: Ahanu
6362-progress.text: There is dust on your shoulders that must be from the Barrens.  You have spoken with my friend Jahan?
6362-progress.title: Ride to Thunder Bluff

6363-progress.name: Tal
6363-progress.text: Greetings, $c.  What can I do for you?
6363-progress.title: Tal the Wind Rider Master

6364-progress.name: Jahan Hawkwing
6364-progress.text: $N, you are back from Thunder Bluff?  Did you deliver the hides to Ahanu?
6364-progress.title: Return to Jahan

6381-progress.name: Tammra Windfield
6381-progress.text:
These seeds you plant are strong, resisting corruption, and making a foothold for other life. They will grow and grow, first preventing corruption and healing the scarred land, and then one day, restoring Stonetalon to a lush forest, once again.

Have you planted all of the Gaea seeds?
6381-progress.title: New Life

6393-progress.name: Tsunaman
6393-progress.text: The Tribunal of the Tides grows impatient. They seek to end this war that has raged across all dimensions for eons. My brethren are anxious to hear news of the glorious victory over the hated fire elementals. Have you the Incendrites that I require?
6393-progress.title: Elemental War

6503-progress.name: Kuray'bin
6503-progress.text: I await reports of your outrunner kills, $N.
6503-progress.title: Ashenvale Outrunners

6581-progress.name: Pixel
6581-progress.text:
Direct from Ratchet, the Warsong saw blades! Yep, I have them right here.

..But what sort of payment do you have for me? You can't just take them, you know! My time isn't cheap!

What I really need is a good gun to carry with me on my travels. A girl's gotta protect herself, you know? There's a gun I really like that I'm sure an engineer would have no problem making.

So, if you bring me a deadly blunderbuss, I'll give you the saw blade shipment. Do we have a deal?
6581-progress.title: Warsong Saw Blades

78143-progress.name: Owen Thadd
78143-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78143-progress.title: Secrets of the Dreamers

79096-complete.name: Owen Thadd
79096-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
79096-complete.title: Ataeric: On Arcane Curiosities

79096-progress.name: Owen Thadd
79096-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79096-progress.title: Ataeric: On Arcane Curiosities

844-progress.name: Sergra Darkthorn
844-progress.text: Have you collected the plainstrider beaks?
844-progress.title: Plainstrider Menace

845-progress.name: Sergra Darkthorn
845-progress.text: How many zhevra have you slain?
845-progress.title: The Zhevra

853-progress.name: Apothecary Zamah
853-progress.text: You have something from Apothecary Helbrim?
853-progress.title: Apothecary Zamah

86576-progress.name: Mor'rogal
86576-progress.text: I have important matters to consider, $c. Be quick.
86576-progress.title: Bloodfury Trinkets

903-progress.name: Sergra Darkthorn
903-progress.text: How goes your hunt, $N?  Have you found the prowlers?
903-progress.title: Prowlers of the Barrens
